watch.summary: The creator explains why he refuses to refresh his browser during a high-traffic GTA VI stream event, fearing he will lose his spot in queue.

beats.what: Creator notes that streaming sites are crashing due to GTA VI traffic.
He stubbornly declares he will not refresh or touch anything to avoid getting put into a queue.
He quietly realizes he already closed his other tab.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: I closed my other tab. Do... I shouldn't have closed that tab.
watch.why: This clip functions primarily as live commentary during a major online event rather than a comedy bit. The only small comic beat is his mild regret right at the end when he realizes he closed a tab.
